question: Will the supplier's replacement part (SYNTHETIC example) ship to us by the date below?
resolution_criterion: A delivery note for the part dated on or before 31 January 2027, as recorded in our receiving log.

scenarios.name: Ships on time
scenarios.basis: Reference class: 7 of the supplier's last 10 quoted lead times on comparable parts were met (our own receiving log, 2025 to 2026).
indicators: A tracking number is issued by 10 January

scenarios.name: Ships late
scenarios.basis: The same 10 orders: 3 were late, by 6 to 19 days. Nothing known makes this order different.
indicators: The supplier revises the quoted date
scenarios.would_falsify: A delivery note dated on or before 31 January

scenarios.name: Does not ship
scenarios.basis: None of the 10 comparable orders was cancelled; the part is in the supplier's current catalogue.
